# Zuhair Alwazzour

> Zuhair Alwazzour (زهير الوزّور) is a Syrian entrepreneur and athlete based in Damascus, and the solo founder of Ostazi, a private tutoring platform serving students across Syria. He is based in Damascus.

## Facts

- Full name: Zuhair Alwazzour (also written Zoher Alwazzour; Arabic: زهير الوزّور)
- Roles: Founder — Ostazi (sole founder); athlete
- Nationality: Syrian
- Also: competitive/practicing athlete based in Damascus
- Location: Damascus, Syria
- Company: Ostazi — https://ostazi-edu.com/ — a private tutoring platform connecting students with vetted private teachers, handling scheduling, payments, and progress tracking.

## Selected work

- Ostazi (https://ostazi-edu.com/) — live private tutoring marketplace for Syria; OTP auth, booking state machine, commission ledger, institute accounts. Designed, built, and run solo.
- open-axis (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/open-axis) — local control plane routing engineering tasks across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with fallback and durable task state.
- kyros (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/kyros) — deterministic task-routing dispatcher + GPU mutex for AI model orchestration, 16/16 tests.
- chrome-agent-bridge (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/chrome-agent-bridge) — CDP-native Chrome control for any AI coding agent.
- ai-security-log-analyzer (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/ai-security-log-analyzer) — deterministic security-log detection engine + local-LLM incident summaries, 12/12 tests.
- nabd (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/nabd) — free-first B2B sales-intelligence engine; archived, code complete.
- open-pinterest (https://github.com/Zuhair-01/open-pinterest) — Claude Code skill for sourcing real design/UI/motion references.
